criteria.statement: Name lookup resolves exact, case-insensitive, accent-folded and front-face names from injected sources and ignores ids absent from card detail
A token loses to a non-token; two non-token matches are unresolved
A present rule id maps to itself; a bare header maps to lettered subrules only; an unknown id excludes the case
Synthetic raw files convert to case files that pass the external-mode loader with the brief's field values
Each exclusion reason is produced by a test and the case file is still written with suite.excluded set
Two converts of the same inputs give identical bytes and the snapshot comes from injected sources
Convert fails loudly on a missing field, makes no network call, and tests use temp folders with invented questions only
package.json has eval:rulesguru:convert and the entry runs the ignore guard first
The REQ-232 entry gains the convert, name lookup, header and excluded criteria
